full_text:
Daily Millionaire - A new lottery game
This is an international lottery that offers players the chance to win a grand prize of $1million every day by correctly selecting 6 numbers out of 52.
And that’s not the only way to become a millionaire. This new lottery also includes a special bonus called the “Millionaire Flood.” A portion of the stakes from each draw is collected into the “Millionaire Fund.” The money from this fund is distributed to lucky players on the day when all the drawn numbers are either even or odd. Statistically, this event occurs approximately every 6 weeks. For example, if there are $15.5 million in the “Millionaire Fund” on that day, 15 players will be randomly selected based on the serial number of their tickets. Each of these 15 players will win $1 million.
The price for one entry is $2.
It will be possible to subscribe to this lottery for a week, a month, or longer, ensuring that players won’t miss the draw during the “Millionaire Flood.” It will also be possible to purchase a share of a long-term bet, such as one-tenth of a monthly ticket for $4.50, and so on.
Drawings will take place every evening in Europe.
In Illinois, tickets for this lottery will be available at usual retail outlets, online on the State lottery website, or via the gaming app.

full_text:
Thunderball inspired - A new lottery game
This is an international lottery that offers players the chance to win a grand prize of  $1 million every day by correctly guessing 5 numbers out of 39 and 1 number out of 14.
And that's not the only way to become a millionaire. This new lottery also includes a special bonus called the “Flood of Millionaires.” A portion of the stakes from each draw is collected in the “Millionaire Fund.” The money from this Fund is distributed among lucky players on the day when all 5 drawn numbers are either even or all odd. This event is theoretically expected to happen every 8 weeks. For example, if on that day the “Millionaire Fund” has accumulated  $ 10.5 million, 10 players will be selected based on the serial number of their ticket. Each of these 10 players will win $1 million.
The price of one line is $2.
It will be possible to subscribe to this lottery for a week, a month, or longer, so players can be sure not to miss a draw when the “Flood of Millionaires“ occurs. It will also be possible to buy a share in a long-term bet, e.g., one-tenth of a monthly ticket for $6, etc.
The draws would take place every evening in Austria.
In Illinois, this lottery would be available at all usual sales points of the State Lottery, online on the website, or in the lottery app.
